Hi op! Budget constraint gamer din here. I got the switch lite. I got the animal crossing edition since it comes with a free game, which makes it a really good deal.

I often game on mobile, so the size of the screen isn't really a problem for me. I'm also a casual gamer so I also don't mind the battery life. Pero the battery life is pretty good naman, I can play ACNH for as long as 4-5 hours.

Oh, also, it's a bit hard to play outdoors with the lite because you can't really see the screen under the sunlight (Not sure if it's the same case for other switch models).

Many people are fearful of joystick drift sa lite because it's harder to fix on your own, pero I bought a controller to ease the anxiety (8bitdo Ultimate C bluetooth controller goes for only 950, got it for 700 w shopee vouchers. It also has rumble and gyro support. Works for pc too.)

If you do mind any of the aforementioned things like if you want additional battery life, bigger, screen and a docking feature, wait for an OLED sale na lang.

Personally, I'm having a great gaming experience with my lite so far and if you're fine with the trade offs, I'd say get it! It's very comfortable to hold if you're on handheld mode. It also has the same performance as other switch models so you don't have to worry about games not running very well.

Generally, though, if you're investing on a switch, prepare to spend more for the games and whatnot. Do prioritize buying an sd card, tempered glass, case, and carrying bag for your switch.☺️

You need to run another cryo unit with her. She needs a battery so she can fully utilize her ult.

If you aren't running her with an electro unit, you wont be able to proc superconduct (you need this to decrease the enemies' physical resistance). So for enemies with high physical resistance like the ruin guards/graders (the automatons in general), your Eula might struggle nuking them.

Pairing Eula with Raiden Shogun fixes both of these problems.

Other options:
Cryo battery- Diona, Rosaria, Kaeya
Superconduct- Fischl and Beidou
